PWA Icon Generator for Blendcraft Studio

Use this page to generate PWA icons from the Blendcraft logo.

Instructions:

  1. Open /src/imports/blendcraft-logo.svg in an image editor
  2. Export at 192x192px → save as icon-192.png
  3. Export at 512x512px → save as icon-512.png
  4. Place both files in /public/ directory

Quick SVG to PNG (Online Tools):

  • SVG to PNG Converter
  • CloudConvert
  • Favicon Generator

Or Use Placeholder Icons:

Until you create proper icons, PWA will work without them (just no install icon).

The manifest.json references icon-192.png and icon-512.png.

Current Logo Preview:

Check: /src/imports/blendcraft-logo.svg

This should be used as the base for PWA icons.

Testing Without Icons:

The PWA will still work! Icons are only needed for:

  • Install button in browser
  • Home screen icon (mobile)
  • Splash screen
  • Task switcher

All other PWA features (offline, caching, updates) work without icons.
